checkpoints.name: pre_transfer_idle
checkpoints.description: Reset just released; SCLK low (CPOL=0), CS_n high, MOSI 0. Idle state of a mode-0 SPI bus.

checkpoints.name: first_byte_cs_asserted
checkpoints.description: First byte (0x12) starts: CS_n is dropped at t=60 ns and the MSB of 0x12 (bit value 0) is presented on MOSI.

checkpoints.name: first_byte_complete
checkpoints.description: After 8 SCLK cycles (1620 ns from CS_n drop) the master raises CS_n at t=1680 ns and the slave latches 0x12 into last_byte.

checkpoints.name: inter_byte_gap
checkpoints.description: Between bytes the master holds CS_n high for 400 ns. The slave's last_byte holds the previous capture.

checkpoints.name: third_byte_complete
checkpoints.description: Third byte (0x56) latched. Per-byte cadence is 2040 ns including the gap: bytes complete at 1680, 3720, 5760, 7800 ns.

checkpoints.name: fourth_byte_complete
checkpoints.description: Final byte (0x78) latched at t=7800 ns. Bus returns to idle thereafter.
